papers.evidence: 06-fused-attention.py:5 'This is a Triton implementation of the Flash Attention v2 algorithm from Tri Dao (https://tridao.me/publications/flash2/flash2.pdf)'. Kernel inner loop performs block-wise softmax with running m_i/l_i/acc rescaling — the reader cannot follow the bookkeeping without deriving online-softmax tiling + v2 work-partitioning. Rabe/Staats is the lazy-softmax predecessor (a box inside the primer); Milakov is the online-normalizer origin for the fused-softmax tutorial. Ascend reuses the same math, remapped onto Cube+Vector double cores.

key_figures.shows: 在线 softmax 一遍过:running max m_j=max(m_{j-1},x_j) 与 running sum d_j=d_{j-1}·e^{m_{j-1}-m_j}+e^{x_j-m_j} 边扫边更新;高亮某步 x_j 刷新最大值时旧 d_{j-1} 被 e^{m_{j-1}-m_j}<1 因子'降标度'(rescale 雏形),对比朴素三遍扫描(先 max、再分母、再归一化)
key_figures.why_essential: 全章唯一把'softmax 为何能一遍过、不等整行看完'画清的图——rescale 因子的直觉不靠这张递推图讲不清;是 FlashAttention 分块 rescale 的数学地基。可从 06-fused-attention.py:57-63 逐行坐实

key_figures.shows: 外层锁一块 Q(BLOCK_M 常驻 SRAM),内层水平铺开 K/V 块逐块流过;每块四步 qk=q·Kjᵀ→m_ij 抬 running max→alpha=exp2(m_i-m_ij) 把旧 acc/l_i 整体乘 α 降标度(醒目缩放箭头)→acc=α·acc+P̃·Vj 增量累加;标注 m_i/l_i/acc 全为 O(block)、全程无 N×N 落地;末尾 epilogue acc/l_i 一次归一化
key_figures.why_essential: 全章把'分块遍历+rescale 恒等于全矩阵 softmax、不物化 N×N'画实的落点图——FlashAttention 为何省显存又快一图看懂;锚 06-fused-attention.py:46-74 内层循环+:185-186 归一化
